name: Desktop Client
commonFailureModes: Desktop must not publish raw frames or audio; only compact perception_event records cross the Runtime Bridge.
Floating-bar chat and push-to-talk must join the one Companion conversation instead of creating a separate desktop chat store.
Swift Codable protocol fixtures must stay aligned with packages/protocol/test/fixtures.
Desktop CI and release jobs are path-sensitive; shared package changes can still affect Desktop assumptions.
reviewHints: Provider changes should inspect desktop auth and telemetry seams.
Protocol changes should inspect Runtime Bridge Codable fixtures, perception publishing, and delivery acknowledgements.
